**保留/更换策略与方法（第1行）：**保留“双靶点立即早期基因免疫标记：C-FoS + Npas4（均用 Alexa Fluor 二抗区分通道）”，更换透明方法为 **iDISCO+**（替代简化 CUBIC；用于完整成年小鼠全脑更均一脱脂与RI匹配，深部成像更稳定）。  
**Justification:** 你现有“CUBIC-L 2天 + CUBIC-RA 1天”对完整成年小鼠全脑通常脱脂不足且RI匹配时间过短，易出现边缘/中心不均与深部散射；iDISCO+ 的甲醇脱水+有机溶剂脱脂对全脑更彻底，配合长时间全脑免疫渗透更适合做单细胞分辨率全脑IEG亚群分布比较（C-FoS vs Npas4），且不引入列表外靶点/荧光团。

**Protocol Steps（仅列透明处理、RI匹配和保存/成像前处理关键步骤；含双靶点标记整合）：**

1 预处理与脱水（iDISCO+ MeOH 梯度）
1.1 PBS 清洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 振荡孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.3 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.4 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.5 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.6 100% (vol/vol) methanol（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  
1.7 100% (vol/vol) methanol 过夜充分脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–16 h）

2 漂白/去背景（降低自发荧光，利于深部信噪比）
2.1 5% H2O2 in methanol（配制：1 vol 30% H2O2 + 5 vol MeOH）（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
2.2 100% methanol 清洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）

3 复水（为全脑免疫渗透做准备）
3.1 80% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.2 60% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.3 40% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.4 20% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.5 PBS（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）

4 渗透与封闭（全脑抗体进入的关键）
4.1 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h）  
4.2 渗透/封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h）  
4.3 封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h）

5 一抗孵育（双靶点：C-FoS + Npas4）
5.1 一抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% normal donkey serum + 抗 C-FoS + 抗 Npas4（各按常用全脑iDISCO滴度起始：1:200–1:500；总体积需完全浸没全脑）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days）  

6 洗涤（长洗去非特异，保证单细胞计数可靠）
6.1 洗液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×4 h）  
6.2 同洗液继续洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days；每天换液 3–4 次）

7 二抗孵育（仅用列表内荧光团：Alexa Fluor）
7.1 二抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 3% normal donkey serum + 目标物种匹配二抗-Alexa Fluor（建议两通道分离如 Alexa Fluor 647 与 Alexa Fluor 568/594；各 1:300–1:500）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days，避光）  

8 二抗后洗涤（降低背景、提升深部对比）
8.1 PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×4 h，避光）  
8.2 同洗液继续洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days；每天换液 3–4 次，避光）

9 再脱水（为有机相脱脂与RI匹配做准备）
9.1 20% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
9.2 40% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
9.3 60% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
9.4 80% methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
9.5 100% methanol（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  
9.6 100% methanol（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–16 h）

10 脱脂（深部透明度与均一性的核心）
10.1 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h）  
10.2 100% DCM（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30–60 min；组织应明显变“玻璃样”半透明）

11 RI 匹配（成像前最终透明与折射率匹配）
11.1 二苯醚/苄醇体系（DBE, refractive index ~1.56）完全浸没（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h）  
11.2 新鲜 DBE 继续匹配至全脑均一透明（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h，避光）

12 保存与成像前处理（用于全脑三维成像/配准/计数）
12.1 DBE 中避光保存（Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: 可达数周；建议充氮/满液减少氧化与背景）  
12.2 成像前更换一次新鲜 DBE 并静置脱气/去微泡（Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 h）  
12.3 光片成像装样：使用与 DBE 兼容的样品仓与胶/夹具固定，确保样品完全浸没于 DBE（Temperature: RT, Time: 立即进行成像）

**Protocol Steps：**

1 预处理与脱色（为全脑免疫与深部成像做准备）  
1.1 PBS 漂洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水梯度脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）

1.7 5% H2O2 in 甲醇（体积比：30% H2O2 : 甲醇 = 1:5，新鲜配制）（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
1.8 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  
1.9 80%→60%→40%→20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水 反向复水（Temperature: RT, Time: 各1 h）  
1.10 PBS 漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）

2 渗透/封闭（iDISCO+ 免疫前关键步骤）  
2.1 渗透液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h，轻柔摇晃）  
2.2 封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% 正常驴血清（NDS）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h，轻柔摇晃）

3 一抗孵育（双靶点：C-FoS 与 Npas4）  
3.1 一抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL 肝素 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS + 抗 C-FoS + 抗 Npas4（各按 1:200–1:500 起始优化；总体积需完全浸没全脑）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 d，持续轻柔摇晃）  

4 洗涤（降低背景、保证深部特异性）  
4.1 洗液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL 肝素（PTwH）（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h）  
4.2 PTwH 长洗（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2–3 d，每12–24 h换液，轻柔摇晃）

5 二抗孵育（Alexa Fluor 双通道）  
5.1 二抗工作液：PTwH + 3% NDS + 5% DMSO + 驴抗对应宿主二抗-Alexa Fluor（两种不同发射波段；各 1:300–1:500）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 d，避光、轻柔摇晃）

6 二抗后洗涤（为脱水/透明做准备）  
6.1 PTwH 洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h，避光）  
6.2 PTwH 长洗（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2–3 d，每12–24 h换液，避光）

7 脱水（进入有机相透明流程；提高均一性）  
7.1 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
7.2 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
7.3 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
7.4 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
7.5 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）

8 脂质去除/透明化（iDISCO+ 关键：DCM 脱脂）  
8.1 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)/33% 甲醇（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h）  
8.2 100% (vol/vol) DCM（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30–60 min）

9.2 新鲜 100% DBE 继续匹配至完全均一透明（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h，避光；体积≥样本10×）

10.1 DBE 中避光保存（Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: 可达数周；建议充满容器减少氧化）  
10.2 成像前更换新鲜 DBE 去除微粒与析出（Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 h，避光）

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Npas4 (IEGs) / C-Fos, tdTomato]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for whole adult mouse brains due to its high transparency and excellent fluorescence preservation, especially for endogenous or transgenic fluorescent markers like tdTomato. It uses organic solvents that effectively clear large tissues while maintaining signal integrity. The use of Npas4 and C-Fos as IEGs allows precise identification of activated neurons post-behavioral stimulation, and tdTomato provides a robust red fluorescent signal for single-cell resolution imaging. This method also supports RI matching with refractive index-matched immersion oil for light-sheet microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.6 Incubation with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with primary antibody against Npas4 (1:500 dilution in iDISCO+ labeling solution) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500 dilution in iDISCO+ labeling solution) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with tdTomato-labeled cells (if using transgenic mice; no additional steps required) (Temperature: RT, Time: 0 hours)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (100% vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (100% vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (100% vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Incubation with refractive index-matched immersion oil (RI = 1.51) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Mounting on a glass slide with a coverslip and immersion oil for light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos, Npas4]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly suitable for whole adult mouse brain clearing, offering excellent tissue penetration, rapid processing, and strong preservation of fluorescence signals from endogenous reporters and immunolabeled immediate early gene (IEG) proteins like c-Fos and Npas4. It is particularly effective for 3D imaging and spatial mapping of sparse neuronal activation patterns across the whole brain. The methanol-based delipidation minimizes tissue swelling and maintains structural integrity, while the refractive index matching ensures high-resolution imaging deep within the tissue. This method is compatible with commonly used fluorophores (e.g., Alexa Fluor, GFP, tdTomato) and avoids the need for additional labeling beyond the two IEGs of interest.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with chilled 100% methanol (freshly prepared) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 1:2 (vol/vol) H2O2:methanol solution (1 volume of 30% H2O2 in 2 volumes of methanol) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Replace with fresh H2O2:methanol solution (1:2) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Wash with 100% methanol (3×, 1 hour each) (Temperature: 4 °C)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with PBS (3×, 1 hour each) (Temperature: 4 °C)  

4 Immunolabeling  
4.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% donkey serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-c-Fos (1:1000) and anti-Npas4 (1:500) in labeling buffer (1% donkey serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
4.3 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (5×, 24 hours each) (Temperature: 4 °C)  
4.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rabbit (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647 anti-mouse (1:500) in labeling buffer (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
4.5 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (5×, 24 hours each) (Temperature: 4 °C)  

5 Dehydration  
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (v/v) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (3×, 1 hour each) (Temperature: 4 °C)  

6 Delipidation and Clearing  
6.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol (1:1 vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Replace with fresh DCM:methanol (1:1) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with 100% DCM (2×, 1 hour each) (Temperature: RT)  

7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
7.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Replace with fresh DBE (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Imaging and Storage  
8.1 Mount brain in DBE-filled imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy  
8.2 Store in DBE at RT in the dark for long-term preservation

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-Fos + Alexa Fluor 488 antibody, Npas4 + Alexa Fluor 594 antibody]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for whole mouse brain clearing with strong fluorescence preservation and delipidation efficiency. It allows deep imaging of fluorescent signals in intact brains, which is essential for mapping activated neurons at single-cell resolution across the entire brain. The methanol-based protocol is compatible with lipid-soluble dyes and secondary antibodies used for IEG labeling (e.g., C-Fos and Npas4). This method also provides more uniform clearing than simplified CUBIC protocols, especially for large tissue volumes like adult mouse brains.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol containing 10% (vol/vol) DMSO and 3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (DMSO/Triton solution) (Temperature: RT, Time: 72 hours)  
2.2 Replace DMSO/Triton solution every 24 hours to maintain reagent activity

3 Wash  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS only (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4 Immunostaining (Optional if endogenous IEGs are not sufficient or need amplification)  
4.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with primary antibodies:  
  – Anti-C-Fos (1:500 dilution)  
  – Anti-Npas4 (1:500 dilution)  
  in PBS with 2% normal goat serum and 0.3% Triton X-100 (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies:  
  – Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-species IgG (1:500)  
  – Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-species IgG (1:500)  
  in PBS with 2% normal goat serum and 0.3% Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.4 Incubation with PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour for washing)

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution: 60% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE), 30% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF), 10% (vol/vol) 2,2-thiodiethanol (TDE) in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with final clearing solution: 100% DBE (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Mount sample in DBE for light-sheet microscopy or confocal imaging  
6.2 Store cleared brain in DBE at 4 ℃ until imaging

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos, Npas4, Alexa Fluor 488 / Alexa Fluor 594]  
**Justification:** The original CUBIC protocol failed due to insufficient delipidation and poor penetration in dense adult mouse brain tissue. iDISCO+ is superior for whole adult mouse brains because it combines effective methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane (DCM)-based delipidation, enabling deep, homogeneous clearing while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing robust immunolabeling of nuclear immediate early gene (IEG) products like c-Fos and Npas4. These two IEGs define distinct activated neuron subpopulations with different temporal dynamics and functional roles. Using directly conjugated Alexa Fluor secondary antibodies ensures high signal-to-noise, compatibility with iDISCO+ organic solvents, and minimal cross-talk for dual-channel imaging at single-cell resolution.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-c-Fos (e.g., Santa Cruz sc-52, 1:500) and anti-Npas4 (e.g., Cell Signaling #14299, 1:250) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)  

6 Washes after Primary Antibody  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 changes)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500), both diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Washes after Secondary Antibody  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 changes)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer brain to glass vial filled with fresh DBE and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite for short-term; image within 1 week for optimal fluorescence)

**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488, GFAP + Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for large, myelinated tissues like the rat spinal cord. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane (DCM) delipidation steps are essential for removing the high lipid content of the spinal cord, ensuring deep transparency. The protocol allows for robust whole-mount immunolabeling of axons (TUJ1) and the glial scar (GFAP) across the 15 mm injury segment, enabling 3D reconstruction of axon paths relative to the lesion center.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pretreatment and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with a methanol/H2O gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% vol/vol) for 1 hour each step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
1.2 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce background autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Rehydration with a methanol/H2O gradient (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% vol/vol) for 1 hour each step, followed by PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 2.3% Glycine, and 20% DMSO).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 6% BSA, and 10% DMSO).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (TUJ1 and GFAP) diluted in PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% BSA.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.4 Washing with PTwH for 5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647) diluted in PTwH containing 3% BSA.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.6 Washing with PTwH for 5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with a methanol/H2O gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, 100% vol/vol) for 1 hour each step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 66% Dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% Methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

1.14 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.15 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) and anti-GFAP, 1:200 dilution) in PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 µg/ml heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

3.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to wash out methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
3.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MBP+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ method is highly effective for clearing large, dense tissue blocks like the 15 mm rat spinal cord segment, providing excellent transparency and deep antibody penetration. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps efficiently remove lipids while preserving endogenous GFP fluorescence, allowing for the visualization of transgenic axons. The use of an anti-MBP antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 provides robust labeling of the myelin sheath, enabling the analysis of axon-myelin spatial relationships and the structural integrity of the white matter tracts surrounding the injury site.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.9 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.10 Wash with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Wash with 50% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.12 Wash with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.13 Wash with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.14 Wash with PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3% Glycine, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody Rabbit anti-MBP (1:500) in permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 3% Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2.7 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.8 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in permeabilization solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.9 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.10 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.11 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.12 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.13 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, GAP-43/Tuj1 replaced by → β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 546 & GFAP + Alexa Fluor 647]

> 具体双靶点策略：**β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)** 标记所有轴突/神经纤维骨架（保留轴突 + 再生轴突均可见）；**GFAP** 标记反应性星形胶质细胞及胶质瘢痕边界，用于界定损伤中心位置并区分轴突是否穿越/绕行瘢痕区域。二抗分别偶联 **Alexa Fluor 546**（TUJ1）和 **Alexa Fluor 647**（GFAP），两通道光谱分离良好，适合光片显微镜成像。

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 采用有机溶剂（甲醇脱水 + DBE 折射率匹配），对 15 mm × 4 mm 的大鼠脊髓节段具有优异的深层组织穿透和透明效果，透明周期可控（约 5–7 天），且与免疫荧光抗体标记高度兼容。相较于水性方法（CUBIC、ScaleS），iDISCO+ 对该尺寸脊髓组织的透明效率更高，背景更低。双靶点选择 TUJ1（β-III Tubulin）+ GFAP 的组合可同时重建轴突三维走行路径（TUJ1）和损伤区胶质瘢痕空间边界（GFAP），直接回答轴突是否接近、绕行或穿越损伤中心的科学问题，并可分析损伤上下游轴突的连续性与方向性。Alexa Fluor 546/647 在有机溶剂中荧光稳定性优于短波长染料，适合 iDISCO+ 流程。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理（Post-fixation 后处理）**
1.1 将已完成 4% PFA 灌流固定及后固定（4% PFA，4 ℃，过夜）的大鼠脊髓损伤节段（约 15 mm × 4 mm）用 1× PBS 充分漂洗。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 30 min)
1.2 用锋利手术刀修整样本两端，确保总长度约 15 mm，轻柔去除残余硬脊膜（可选，有助于试剂渗透）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

**2 脱水（Dehydration）**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（第二次，确保完全脱水）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 漂白（Bleaching）**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH, 现配现用) to reduce tissue autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, 避光)

**4 复水（Rehydration）**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Incubation with 1× PBS（第二次漂洗）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 通透与封闭（Permeabilization and Blocking）**
5.1 Incubation with PTwH buffer（1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin）进行漂洗.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)
5.2 Incubation with Permeabilization solution（1× PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M glycine）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, 轻摇)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, GFAP+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing of large, dense tissues (15 mm spinal cord segment), strong fluorescence preservation (critical for tracing fine axonal structures), and compatibility with antibody labeling. The method provides high transparency and tissue shrinkage (~45%), which aids in high-resolution 3D imaging. The dual-labeling strategy targets β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) to visualize all axons/neurites (regenerating and intact) and GFAP to delineate the glial scar/astrocyte boundaries at the injury site. DAPI provides nuclear reference. This combination allows precise mapping of axonal paths relative to the injury core and glial environment.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
2.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeated once until tissue is transparent)

3  Immunostaining (Performed after Step 1.4, before Step 1.5)
3.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 100%, 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each step 1 hour at RT.
3.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-Tx) 3 times, 1 hour each at RT.
3.3 Blocking with 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBS-Tx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: chicken anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and rabbit anti-GFAP (1:400) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
3.5 Wash with PBS-Tx 6 times, 1 hour each at RT.
3.6 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking, protected from light)
3.7 Wash with PBS-Tx 6 times, 1 hour each at RT.
3.8 Counterstain with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.9 Wash with PBS 3 times, 1 hour each at RT.
3.10 Resume dehydration from Step 1.1.

4  Storage and Imaging
4.1 Store cleared sample in fresh dibenzyl ether (DBE) in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.
4.2 For imaging, mount sample in DBE within an appropriate imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, GFAP+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency in large, dense tissues like spinal cord, and its strong compatibility with antibody labeling and fluorescence preservation (especially for Alexa Fluor dyes). The protocol includes a dehydration and delipidation series that effectively clears myelinated neural tissue while maintaining structural integrity for 3D reconstruction. The dual-labeling strategy targets β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) to visualize all axons (regenerating and preserved) and GFAP to demarcate glial scars and injury boundaries, enabling clear discrimination of axonal paths relative to the lesion core. DAPI provides nuclear reference for spatial orientation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

2  Delipidation and Bleaching (optional, if autofluorescence is high)
2.1 Incubation with fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3  Rehydration and Blocking
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
3.5 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBST) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4  Immunostaining
4.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: chicken anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and rabbit anti-GFAP (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)
4.2 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 6 times)
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)
4.4 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 6 times)
4.5 Optional nuclear staining: Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.6 Wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)

5  Final Dehydration
5.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

6  Solvent-Based Clearing and RI Matching
6.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)
6.3 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, then store in fresh DBE for imaging; RI ~1.56)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Dual-Target Labeling:** [Tuj1(β-III Tubulin)+Alexa Fluor 647, GAP43+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ 对 15 mm×4 mm 脊髓段脱脂透明效率高、适配光片三维成像；Alexa Fluor 647/568 在有机溶剂透明体系中相对更稳定。Tuj1 标记整体轴突/神经纤维骨架用于连续性与走行重建；GAP43 标记损伤后再生/生长锥相关轴突用于区分再生/重塑路径并判断是否接近、绕行或穿越损伤中心。

**Protocol Steps:**
1 预处理与脱水（iDISCO+ Methanol series）
1.1 PBS 漂洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.3 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.4 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.5 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.6 100% (vol/vol) methanol 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.7 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) methanol 再孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）

2 漂白/去血红素背景（可显著降低脊髓自发荧光）
2.1 5% H2O2 in methanol（配制：1 体积 30% H2O2 + 5 体积 methanol）孵育（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
2.2 100% methanol 漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）

3 复水（为免疫染色做准备）
3.1 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.2 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.3 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.4 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
3.5 PBS 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）

4 渗透与封闭（iDISCO+ 免疫渗透体系）
4.1 PBS/0.2% Triton X-100（PTx2）孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  
4.2 渗透/封闭液孵育：PTx2 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
4.3 封闭液孵育：PTx2 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）

5 一抗孵育（双靶点：轴突骨架 + 再生轴突）
5.1 一抗工作液：PTx2 + 5% NDS + 5% DMSO + heparin 10 µg/mL；加入 anti-Tuj1(β-III Tubulin) 与 anti-GAP43（各 1:200，或按抗体说明书优化）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days）  

6 一抗洗涤（降低背景、保证深部信噪比）
6.1 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h）  
6.2 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 长洗（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2×12 h）

7 二抗孵育（选择耐溶剂荧光团）
7.1 二抗工作液：PTx2 + 5% NDS + heparin 10 µg/mL；donkey anti-mouse/rabbit（按一抗宿主匹配）+Alexa Fluor 647（用于 Tuj1）与 +Alexa Fluor 568（用于 GAP43），各 1:300（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days，避光）  

8 二抗洗涤
8.1 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h，避光）  
8.2 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 长洗（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2×12 h，避光）

9 再脱水（进入有机相透明）
9.1 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h，避光）  
9.2 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h，避光）  
9.3 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h，避光）  
9.4 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h，避光）  
9.5 100% (vol/vol) methanol 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h，避光）  
9.6 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) methanol 再孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h，避光）

10 脱脂/透明前置换（DCM）
10.1 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h，避光）  
10.2 100% DCM 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min，避光）

11 RI 匹配与最终透明（DBE）
11.1 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI≈1.56) 孵育至完全透明（Temperature: RT, Time: 2–4 h，避光）  
11.2 新鲜 100% DBE 再平衡（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h，避光）

12 保存与成像前处理（适配三维轴突追踪）
12.1 DBE 中避光保存（充满液体、尽量无气泡；容器选玻璃并使用耐溶剂密封）（Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: up to 1–2 weeks）  
12.2 成像前将样本在新鲜 DBE 中充分平衡并去除表面残留颗粒（必要时 0.22 µm 过滤 DBE）（Temperature: RT, Time: 2–4 h）  
12.3 光片成像装样：将脊髓段沿长轴固定于样品夹/毛细管内，保持损伤中心位于视野中部；全程使用 DBE 作为成像介质并避光（Temperature: RT, Time: 立即成像）

model_response:
**所选双靶点荧光/标记策略与透明方法：**[β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 647（全轴突/神经纤维骨架）, GAP43+Alexa Fluor 568（再生/重塑相关生长锥与再生轴突）]；透明方法：iDISCO+  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ 适合 15 mm×4 mm 脊髓段的深度透明与三维成像；有机溶剂脱脂+RI 匹配可获得高透明度与低散射，利于光片/共聚焦追踪长程纤维；TUJ1 提供整体轴突走行骨架，GAP43 强化损伤后再生/重塑相关纤维路径信息，二者互补用于判断接近/绕行/穿越损伤中心及上下游连续性与方向性。

**Protocol Steps:**

1 预处理与脱水（iDISCO+ Methanol series）  
1.1 PBS 漂洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.3 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.4 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.5 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.6 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  
1.7 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇过夜充分脱水（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）

2 漂白/去血红素背景（可显著降低脊髓自发荧光）  
2.1 新鲜 5% H2O2/甲醇（1 体积 30% H2O2 + 5 体积 MeOH）孵育（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 h）  
2.2 100% 甲醇漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）

3 复水（为免疫标记做准备）  
3.1 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.2 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.3 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.4 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.5 PBS 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）

4 渗透与封闭（iDISCO+ 免疫渗透体系）  
4.1 PBS/0.2% Triton X-100（PBST）孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h）  
4.2 渗透液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
4.3 封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）

5 一抗孵育（双靶点）  
5.1 一抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin + 5% DMSO + 3% 正常驴血清；加入 β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) 与 GAP43 一抗（各 1:200）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days，轻柔摇晃）  

6 洗涤（长程组织充分洗去游离抗体）  
6.1 洗液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin（PTwH）漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h）  
6.2 PTwH 长洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days，每日换液 3–4 次）

7 二抗孵育（选择远红/红通道以利深部成像）  
7.1 二抗工作液：PTwH + 3% 正常驴血清 + 5% DMSO；加入 驴抗兔/鼠（按一抗宿主匹配）Alexa Fluor 647（用于 TUJ1）与 Alexa Fluor 568（用于 GAP43），各 1:400（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days，避光轻柔摇晃）

8 二抗后洗涤  
8.1 PTwH 漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h，避光）  
8.2 PTwH 长洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days，避光；每日换液 3–4 次）

9 再脱水（为有机相脱脂与 RI 匹配做准备）  
9.1 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.2 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.3 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.4 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.5 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  
9.6 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇过夜（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）

10 脱脂/透明化（DCM）  
10.1 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)/33% 甲醇混合液孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h）  
10.2 100% DCM 孵育（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  
10.3 100% DCM 延长脱脂（Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 h；组织仍偏白可延长至 3 h）

11 RI 匹配（DBE）  
11.1 100% 二苄醚（DBE，RI≈1.56）预匹配（Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 h，避光）  
11.2 新鲜 100% DBE 完全匹配（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h，避光；直至组织整体均一透明）

12 保存与成像前处理（光片/共聚焦）  
12.1 DBE 中避光保存（Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: 可达数周；建议充满容器减少氧化）  
12.2 成像前将样本固定于耐溶剂样本夹/毛细管或用低熔点琼脂糖预固定后转入 DBE（Temperature: RT, Time: 30–60 min 重新平衡 RI）  
12.3 成像介质使用 DBE；选择 561 nm（AF568）与 640 nm（AF647）通道采集，Z 步进建议 2–5 µm（光片）或 1–3 µm（共聚焦大视野拼接）（Temperature: RT, Time: 按成像体积而定）

**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, MBP]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for clearing rodent spinal cord tissues due to its high fluorescence preservation, compatibility with lipid-soluble dyes like DiI, and ability to maintain structural integrity of long axonal tracts. DiI effectively labels axons and can be used to trace regenerating fibers, while MBP (myelin basic protein) labels myelinated axons, allowing distinction between intact and remyelinated fibers. This combination enables precise 3D reconstruction of both regenerating and preserved axonal pathways in the injured spinal cord.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Labeling  
2.1 Incubation with DiI (1 µg/mL in 100% methanol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)  
2.2 Incubation with MBP antibody (1:500 dilution in 100% methanol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)  
2.3 Washing with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, GAP43+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for large, fixed nervous tissue like spinal cords due to its excellent preservation of fluorescent signals, rapid clearing, and compatibility with multiple antibody labeling. It uses organic solvents to remove lipids, enabling deep penetration and high-resolution 3D imaging with light-sheet or confocal microscopy. β-III Tubulin labels all axons, while GAP43 highlights regenerating axons, allowing distinction between preserved and newly regrown fibers. This dual labeling strategy enables precise 3D reconstruction and analysis of axonal continuity and directionality around the injury site.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-β-III Tubulin (1:1000) and anti-GAP43 (1:500) in labeling solution (1% DMSO, 3% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 7 days)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (or species-matched) at 1:500 dilution in labeling solution for 4 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 days)  
1.5 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Incubation with chilled 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1:20 dilution of 30% H₂O₂ in methanol) overnight. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Wash with 100% methanol, 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 1:1 DCM:BABB (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate, 1:1 vol/vol) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% BABB for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (BABB containing 0.5% (wt/vol) N-phenyl-1-naphthylamine if needed for auto-fluorescence suppression) for at least 24 hours before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Store sample in BABB at RT in the dark until imaging.  
6.2 Mount sample in a custom chamber with BABB to match RI of the objective (e.g., glycerol or BABB-matched immersion objectives).  
6.3 Perform 3D imaging using light-sheet or confocal microscopy optimized for Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 channels.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, Olig2+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for lipid removal in small to medium-sized tissue samples like the rat spinal cord (15 mm length), and it preserves fluorescent signals effectively. DiI is a lipophilic dye that labels axons and myelin sheaths, making it ideal for tracing axonal pathways. Olig2 is a marker of oligodendrocyte lineage cells and can be used with Alexa Fluor 488 to label surviving or regenerating myelinating cells. This dual labeling strategy allows for the visualization of both axonal tracts and their myelination status, which is essential for analyzing regeneration and connectivity.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Lipid Removal (Delipidation)  
2.1 Incubation with 100% methanol + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 100% methanol + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 100% methanol + 30% (vol/vol) DMSO (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 100% methanol + 50% (vol/vol) DMSO (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol + 100% (vol/vol) DMSO (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Clearing Agent Exchange  
3.1 Incubation with 100% DMSO (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE) (Sigma-Aldrich, D1416) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DBE (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with 100% DBE containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

5 Labeling (Pre-clearing)  
5.1 Incubation with DiI (1:1000 dilution in PBS) for intracellular labeling of axons (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Washing with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with anti-Olig2 primary antibody (1:500 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
5.4 Washing with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibody (1:1000 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.6 Washing with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

6 Final Clearing and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Incubation with 100% DBE (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Optional: Add 0.1% (vol/vol) Hoechst 33342 to DBE for nuclear counterstaining (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Wash briefly with fresh DBE (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Storage and Imaging  
7.1 Store sample in 100% DBE at 4 ℃ until imaging  
7.2 For light-sheet microscopy, transfer sample into a custom chamber filled with DBE and cover with a glass slide for imaging

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488, GFAP + Alexa Fluor 594]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for fixed rodent spinal cord tissue (~15 mm length) due to its strong delipidation capacity, compatibility with endogenous and antibody-based fluorescence, and excellent preservation of fine axonal structures over millimeter-scale distances. The method enables deep imaging of intact tissue without hydrogel embedding, which is critical for tracing long-range axonal trajectories across injury sites. The dual-labeling strategy uses β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)—a pan-neuronal marker labeling all axons including regenerating fibers—and GFAP to visualize reactive astrocytes forming the glial scar around the lesion core. This combination allows precise spatial correlation between regenerating/elongating axons and the inhibitory glial environment, enabling analysis of whether axons approach, circumvent, or penetrate the injury epicenter.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer: anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and anti-GFAP (1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), plus 5 µg/mL DAPI for nuclear counterstain.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1), MBP, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is the optimal choice for large, dense CNS samples like a 15 mm rat spinal cord segment. Its methanol-based pretreatment and bleaching steps significantly enhance antibody penetration and reduce the high background autofluorescence typically found in spinal cord injury sites (due to heme and lipofuscin). By using β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) to label the total axonal cytoskeleton and MBP to label mature myelin, the protocol allows for the simultaneous visualization of regenerating/remodeling fibers (TUJ1+/MBP-) and surviving mature axons (TUJ1+/MBP+), directly addressing the scientific goal of assessing the relationship between regeneration and survival in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pretreatment (Dehydration and Bleaching)
1.1 Incubation with 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solutions sequentially for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol twice for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol) to bleach the tissue. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solutions sequentially for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.5 Incubation with PBS/0.2% Triton X-100 (PTx2) twice for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (PTx2 / 2.3% (wt/vol) Glycine / 20% (vol/vol) DMSO). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)
2.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PTx2 / 6% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum / 10% (vol/vol) DMSO). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

3 Immunostaining (Labeling)
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) and MBP diluted in PTwH (PBS/0.2% Tween-20 with 10 μg/ml Heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.2 Incubation with PTwH for washing, 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 conjugated antibodies diluted in PTwH containing 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.4 Incubation with PTwH for washing, 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Dehydration and Clearing (RI Matching)
4.1 Incubation with 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solutions sequentially for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol twice for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 100% Dichloromethane (DCM) for delipidation until the sample sinks. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.4 Incubation with 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
4.5 Storage in fresh 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE) in a glass vial protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MBP+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ method is highly effective for clearing dense, myelinated tissues like the 15 mm rat spinal cord segment, providing excellent transparency and deep penetration for immunolabeling. The methanol dehydration step efficiently removes lipids (myelin), which is critical for imaging axonal structures. The chosen labeling strategy allows for the simultaneous visualization of regenerating/reorganized fibers (via endogenous GFP, commonly used in neural tracing models) and the structural integrity of the myelin sheath or surviving axons (via MBP antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647), directly addressing the scientific goal of assessing axon regeneration versus survival.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
1.10 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 20 minutes (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.7 hours)
1.11 Bleaching with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.12 Wash with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.13 Wash with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.14 Permeabilization with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.15 Blocking with 0.2% Tween-20, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody (Rabbit anti-MBP) diluted 1:500 in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
2.2 Wash with PTwH for 1 day (change solution 3-5 times). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibody (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647) diluted 1:500 in PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
2.4 Wash with PTwH for 1 day (change solution 3-5 times). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 2 hours (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [GAP-43 + Alexa Fluor 647, NF-H (β-III Tubulin/Tuj1) + Alexa Fluor 555]

> **双靶点策略说明：**
> - **靶点1 — 新生/重塑轴突：** GAP-43（生长相关蛋白-43）是轴突生长锥的经典标志物，在损伤后再生或出芽的神经纤维中高表达，而在成熟静止轴突中表达极低，适合标记新生/重塑纤维的空间延伸路径。→ 二抗偶联 **Alexa Fluor 647**（远红通道，穿透深度好）。
> - **靶点2 — 成熟/残存轴突骨架：** **β-III Tubulin（Tuj1）** 标记神经元特异性微管蛋白，在所有神经元轴突（包括成熟残存轴突）中稳定表达，可反映轴突骨架的连续性与密度。→ 二抗偶联 **Alexa Fluor 555**（绿-橙通道）。
> - 两者信号互补，可在同一样本中同时评估"再生新生纤维"与"残存成熟轴突"的三维空间关系。

**Justification:** iDISCO+ 采用有机溶剂（甲醇脱水 + DBE折射率匹配），对直径约4 mm、长15 mm的大鼠脊髓节段具有优异的深层透明效果，可实现全段均一透明；其免疫标记步骤在脱水前完成，抗体渗透效率高，适合厚组织深层抗原标记；Alexa Fluor 647和555在有机溶剂中荧光稳定性良好；整体流程成熟、参数明确，适合光片显微镜（LSFM）三维成像。

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 样本预处理（固定后漂洗）

1.1 将已完成4% PFA固定和后固定的大鼠脊髓损伤节段（约15 mm × 4 mm）置于1× PBS中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min，每次更换新鲜PBS)

1.2 将样本转移至含0.2% Triton X-100的1× PBS（PTx）中进行渗透处理，促进后续抗体渗透。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 2 漂白（Bleaching，消除内源性荧光与血红素）

2.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂溶于甲醇（1体积30% H₂O₂ + 5体积100% MeOH），预冷至4 ℃。将样本置于漂白液中孵育，以消除血红素及内源性荧光背景。
(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.2 取出样本，用100% MeOH漂洗2次，再用PTx漂洗3次，每次更换新鲜溶液。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min PTx漂洗)

---

### 3 封闭与渗透（Pre-immunolabeling Permeabilization & Blocking）

3.1 将样本置于渗透/封闭液（PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum + 0.2% heparin，PTwH = PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL heparin）中孵育，充分封闭非特异性结合位点并增强抗体渗透。
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours，轻摇)

---

### 4 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）

4.1 配制一抗工作液：
- 抗GAP-43抗体（兔源多克隆，如Abcam ab75810），稀释比例 1:500
- 抗β-III Tubulin/Tuj1抗体（小鼠源单克隆，如BioLegend 801201），稀释比例 1:500
- 溶于PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum + 0.2% heparin

将样本完全浸没于一抗工作液中，密封孵育。
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days，轻摇，每2天更换一次新鲜一抗液)

4.2 一抗孵育结束后，用PTwH漂洗样本，去除未结合抗体。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，每次更换新鲜PTwH)

---

### 5 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）

5.1 配制二抗工作液：
- 驴抗兔-Alexa Fluor 647（标记GAP-43），稀释比例 1:500
- 驴抗小鼠-Alexa Fluor 555（标记Tuj1/β-III Tubulin），稀释比例 1:500
- 溶于PTwH + 3% donkey serum + 0.2% heparin

将样本完全浸没于二抗工作液中，避光密封孵育。
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days，避光轻摇，每2天更换一次新鲜二抗液)

5.2 二抗孵育结束后，用PTwH充分漂洗样本，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，每次更换新鲜PTwH，避光)

---

### 6 脱水（Dehydration，Methanol Gradient）

6.1 将样本置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育，开始梯度脱水。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.2 将样本置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.3 将样本置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.4 将样本置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.5 将样本置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第一次。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.6 将样本置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第二次，确保完全脱水。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 7 脱脂（Delipidation，DCM处理）

7.1 将样本置于二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）与甲醇的混合液（33% DCM / 67% MeOH，vol/vol）中孵育，开始脱脂。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours，轻摇)

7.2 将样本转移至100% DCM中孵育，完成深度脱脂，直至样本沉入管底（表明脱水脱脂完全）。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min，每次更换新鲜DCM)

---

### 8 折射率匹配（RI Matching，DBE浸泡）

8.1 将完成脱脂的样本直接转移至100% 苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇混合液（DBE，dibenzyl ether，Sigma 108014；RI ≈ 1.562）中孵育，避光静置，直至样本完全透明（呈玻璃状）。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 第一次：3 hours，随后更换新鲜DBE继续孵育 12–24 hours，避光，不振摇)

8.2 观察样本透明度，若中心区域仍有不透明区域，继续在新鲜DBE中延长孵育至完全透明。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 最长可延长至48 hours，视透明效果而定)

---

### 9 成像前处理与保存（Pre-imaging Preparation & Storage）

9.1 将完全透明的样本转移至新鲜DBE中，置于适配光片显微镜（LSFM，如LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II 或 Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1）的样本槽或折射率匹配成像腔中，确保样本完全浸没于DBE（RI ≈ 1.562）中，与物镜浸没介质RI匹配。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前静置平衡 30 min)

9.2 成像完成后，样本可长期保存于密封的100% DBE中，避光、室温保存。
(Temperature: RT，避光密封保存，可保存数月)

> **成像建议：** 使用光片显微镜（LSFM）进行三维全段扫描，推荐激发/发射通道：Alexa Fluor 555（Ex 555 nm / Em 580 nm，Tuj1残存轴突）；Alexa Fluor 647（Ex 647 nm / Em 670 nm，GAP-43新生轴突）。Z步长建议2–5 μm，以实现轴突连续性的高分辨率三维重建。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Neurofilament-H (NF-H)+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency in dense neural tissues (like spinal cord), strong fluorescence preservation for Alexa Fluor dyes over weeks, and compatibility with whole-organ imaging. The method uses tetrahydrofuran (THF) and dibenzyl ether (DBE) for efficient delipidation and refractive index matching (RI ~1.56), ideal for light-sheet microscopy of ~15 mm long samples. The dual-target strategy labels regenerating/remodeling axons (β-III Tubulin, early marker) and mature/residual axons (Neurofilament-H, structural marker), plus DAPI for nuclear reference, enabling simultaneous 3D analysis of axonal regeneration versus survival.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeat once)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  

2 Immunostaining (Performed after Step 1.5, before DCM)  
2.1 Rehydration through THF series: 100% → 80% → 60% → 40% → 20% THF in PBS (each step: Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour).  
2.2 Blocking and permeabilization with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum, and 0.1% sodium azide. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: chicken anti-β-III Tubulin (1:500) and rabbit anti-Neurofilament-H (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.4 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with 3 changes)  
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), plus 1 µg/mL DAPI in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.6 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with 3 changes)  
2.7 Dehydration through THF series: 20% → 40% → 60% → 80% → 100% THF in distilled water (each step: Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours).  

3 Refractive Index Matching  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeat once until tissue sinks)  
3.2 Storage in fresh DBE in a light-tight container. (Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging, RI = 1.56)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Neurofilament-H (NF-H)+Alexa Fluor 647, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency in dense neural tissue (rat spinal cord, ~15 mm length, ~4 mm diameter), strong fluorescence preservation for Alexa Fluor dyes, and compatibility with whole-mount immunolabeling. The method uses tert-butanol and diphenyl ether for rapid dehydration and delipidation, yielding a refractive index (~1.56) suitable for high-resolution light-sheet imaging. The dual-target strategy labels regenerating/remodeling axons (β-III Tubulin, early marker) and mature/residual axons (Neurofilament-H, structural marker), while Hoechst stains nuclei for spatial reference. This allows simultaneous 3D mapping of axonal regeneration trends and survival/continuity changes.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane and 33% (vol/vol) methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2  Immunolabeling (Whole-Mount)  
2.1 Permeabilization with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Blocking with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum in PBS for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-β-III Tubulin (1:500) and chicken anti-Neurofilament-H (1:500) in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
2.4 Washing with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS, 6 changes over 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
2.6 Washing with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS, 6 changes over 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.7 Nuclear staining with 1 µg/mL Hoechst 33342 in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in H₂O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in H₂O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in H₂O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol for 1 hour, repeated twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
3.6 Incubation with pure diphenyl ether (RI ~1.56) for refractive index matching, until tissue is fully transparent (typically 12–24 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4  Storage and Imaging  
4.1 Store cleared sample in fresh diphenyl ether in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: long-term)  
4.2 Mount sample in diphenyl ether-compatible chamber for light-sheet microscopy.

所选双靶点荧光/标记策略与透明方法：**[β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 647（轴突骨架/残存与成熟轴突） + GAP43+Alexa Fluor 568（再生/重塑轴突）]；透明方法：iDISCO+**。理由：iDISCO+ 适合 15 mm×4 mm 脊髓段的深度透明与三维成像；与有机溶剂 RI 匹配（DBE）兼容光片显微；Alexa Fluor 568/647 在脱水/有机相中相对稳定，适合双通道比较“再生轴突趋势”与“残存轴突连续性/密度”。

**Protocol Steps:**

1 预处理与脱水（iDISCO+）
1.1 PBS 漂洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.3 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.4 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.5 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O 脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.6 100% (vol/vol) methanol 脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  

2 漂白/去血红素背景（可显著降低脊髓自发荧光）
2.1 5% H2O2 in methanol（由 30% H2O2:MeOH=1:5 配制）孵育（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
2.2 100% methanol 漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  

3 复水（为免疫标记做准备）
3.1 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.2 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.3 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.4 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.5 PBS 漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  

4 渗透/封闭（iDISCO+ 免疫渗透体系）
4.1 PBS/0.2% Triton X-100（PTx2）预渗透（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h）  
4.2 渗透液：PTx2 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
4.3 封闭液：PTx2 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  

5 一抗孵育（双靶点）
5.1 一抗工作液：PTx2 + 5% NDS + 10% DMSO + heparin 10 µg/mL；加入 **anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)** 与 **anti-GAP43**（各 1:200，或按抗体说明书在 1:100–1:300 优化）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days，轻柔摇晃）  

6 洗涤（长程去背景，保证 4 mm 直径组织内部信噪比）
6.1 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×2 h）  
6.2 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 继续洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×12 h）  

7 二抗孵育（荧光标记）
7.1 二抗工作液：PTx2 + 3% NDS + heparin 10 µg/mL；加入 **donkey anti-mouse/rabbit Alexa Fluor 647（对应 TUJ1 一抗宿主）** 与 **donkey anti-另一宿主 Alexa Fluor 568（对应 GAP43 一抗宿主）**（各 1:300）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days，避光轻柔摇晃）  

8 二抗后洗涤（避光）
8.1 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×2 h，避光）  
8.2 PTx2 + heparin 10 µg/mL 继续洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×12 h，避光）  

9 再脱水（进入有机透明流程；全程避光）
9.1 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 45 min）  
9.2 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 45 min）  
9.3 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 45 min）  
9.4 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O（Temperature: RT, Time: 45 min）  
9.5 100% (vol/vol) methanol（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  

10 脱脂/透明化前置换（DCM）
10.1 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h）  
10.2 100% DCM 脱脂（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）

所选双靶点荧光/标记策略与透明方法：**[β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/神经纤维骨架，含残存与再生纤维） + GFAP+Alexa Fluor 568（瘢痕/反应性星形胶质边界）]；组织透明方法：iDISCO+**（适合 15 mm×4 mm 脊髓段深部抗体渗透与三维成像，DBE RI 匹配利于光片/共聚焦长程追踪纤维走向与损伤边界关系）。

**Protocol Steps：**
1 预处理与脱水（iDISCO+）
1.1 PBS 漂洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.3 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.4 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.5 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h）  
1.6 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h）  

2 脱色/去血红素背景（可显著降低脊髓自发荧光）
2.1 5% H2O2 in 甲醇（配制：1 体积 30% H2O2 + 5 体积 MeOH）（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
2.2 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  

3 复水（为免疫染色做准备）
3.1 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.2 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.3 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.4 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
3.5 PBS（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  

4 渗透与封闭（iDISCO+ 免疫染色体系）
4.1 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS（PBST）（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h）  
4.2 渗透液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h，轻柔摇晃）  
4.3 封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h，轻柔摇晃）  

5 一抗孵育（双靶点）
5.1 一抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin + 5% DMSO + 3% Normal Donkey Serum；加入 **anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)**（1:300）与 **anti-GFAP**（1:500）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days，轻柔摇晃；建议 15 mL/样本以上体积）  

6 洗涤（降低背景，保证深部特异性）
6.1 洗液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin（PTwH）（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h）  
6.2 PTwH 继续洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 days，每日换液 3–4 次，轻柔摇晃）  

7 二抗孵育（荧光标记）
7.1 二抗工作液：PTwH + 3% Normal Donkey Serum + 5% DMSO；加入 **Donkey anti-mouse (TUJ1) Alexa Fluor 647**（1:400）与 **Donkey anti-rabbit (GFAP) Alexa Fluor 568**（1:400）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days，避光、轻柔摇晃）  

8 二抗后洗涤（避光）
8.1 PTwH 洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h，避光）  
8.2 PTwH 继续洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days，每日换液 3–4 次，避光）  

9 再脱水（进入有机透明与 RI 匹配）
9.1 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.2 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.3 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.4 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min）  
9.5 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×45 min）  

10 脂质透明（iDISCO+）
10.1 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷 DCM + 33% (vol/vol) 甲醇（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h）  
10.2 100% (vol/vol) DCM（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  

11 RI 匹配（成像介质）
11.1 100% (vol/vol) DBE（Dibenzyl ether，RI≈1.56）（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h，避光）  
11.2 新鲜 100% DBE 继续匹配至完全透明（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h，避光；样本较厚可延长至 48 h）  

12 保存与成像前处理
12.1 DBE 中避光保存（Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: ≤2–4 weeks；容器需耐有机溶剂、密封防吸水）  
12.2 成像前将样本固定于光片样品夹/石英成像池中，使用 **DBE 作为成像浸没液**（Temperature: RT, Time: 30–60 min 充分平衡，避光）

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (to label新生/重塑神经纤维), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, to label成熟/残存轴突)]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ 是一种基于甲醇/二甲苯的透明化方法，具有快速、高效、对荧光蛋白（如 GFP）和抗体标记信号的保存性良好等优点，特别适用于中等体积组织（如大鼠脊髓段）。该方法可实现高折射率匹配，适合后续光片显微镜（light-sheet microscopy）或共聚焦成像。GFP 可用于标记新生或重塑的神经纤维，而 β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）是成熟神经元轴突的标志物，能清晰显示残存轴突的骨架结构，从而实现双靶点三维追踪，评估再生与存活轴突的空间关系。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: chicken anti-GFP (1:1000) and mouse anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:1000) in 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100, 6 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated goat anti-chicken IgY (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG (1:500) in 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100, 6 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol, 2 changes, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (1:20 dilution of 30% H₂O₂ in methanol) at 4 °C for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 1:1 DCM:MeOH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 1:1 DCM:MeOH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.6 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.7 Incubation with PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

5 Tissue Optical Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (BABB: benzyl alcohol and benzyl benzoate at 1:2 ratio) for 24–48 hours until fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours)  

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (BABB 1:2 with 0.5% N-phenylglycine or dibutyl phthalate) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount sample in RI-matched chamber with BABB 1:2.  
7.2 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy or high-magnification confocal microscopy.
