1.7 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.9 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.13 Incubation with blocking solution containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 6% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (anti-CD31 and anti-Claudin-5) diluted in PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 µg/ml Heparin) containing 5% (vol/vol) DMSO and 3% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647), Claudin-5 (Alexa Fluor 568), DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior clearing capability and lipid removal efficiency in dense, lipid-rich tumor tissues, allowing deep imaging of the 8 mm tissue block. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps preserve tissue morphology while being compatible with immunolabeling. The chosen labeling strategy targets Lectin (perfused vasculature), Claudin-5 (tight junctions/barrier integrity), and DAPI (nuclei), enabling the simultaneous visualization of vessel morphology, barrier structure, and spatial relationships between the tumor and surrounding brain parenchyma.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Wash with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.9 Wash with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (wt/vol) Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-Claudin-5 (1:500) and Biotinylated Lycopersicon Esculentum Lectin (1:200) in PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum, and 0.01% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)
3.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) and Streptavidin Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 and 5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.4 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)
3.5 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.6 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat twice)
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

6 Refractive Index Matching
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, until sample is transparent)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 568]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it provides excellent whole-tissue delipidation and antibody penetration for large tissue blocks (~8×6×5 mm), making it ideal for deep 3D imaging of tumor-associated vascular networks. The methanol-based dehydration/rehydration cycle and detergent-based permeabilization enable efficient antibody penetration throughout the full depth of the glioblastoma-containing brain block. iDISCO+ is highly compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is optimal for reconstructing 3D vascular atlases. The dual-antibody strategy targets two complementary aspects of the blood-brain barrier (BBB): CD31 (PECAM1) labels pan-endothelial cells to visualize vessel morphology, branching, diameter, density, and continuity across tumor core, tumor margin, and adjacent normal brain; Claudin-5 labels tight junction proteins specifically at the BBB, enabling spatial mapping of BBB integrity and disruption in tumor versus non-tumor regions. Lectin (intravascular perfusion or post-fixation staining) provides an orthogonal vascular lumen label to confirm vessel patency and complement CD31 signal. Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 568 are both highly photostable, compatible with iDISCO+ organic solvent clearing, and spectrally well-separated for simultaneous 3-channel imaging. DBE (dibenzyl ether) as the final RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56) is optimal for LSFM imaging of this tissue size.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-clearing Tissue Preparation**
1.1 Confirm tissue block (~8 mm × 6 mm × 5 mm) has been fixed in 4% PFA/PBS at 4 °C for 24 hours and post-fixed. Wash tissue in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 30 min)
1.2 Optional: Perform intracardiac perfusion with fluorescently conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lectin-DyLight 488, 0.1 mg/mL in PBS, 10 mL) prior to sacrifice and fixation to label perfused vascular lumens. If perfusion was not performed, proceed to immunolabeling step for lectin staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: perfusion ~5 min)

**2 Dehydration**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence from the tumor tissue. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)

**4 Rehydration**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Permeabilization and Blocking**
5.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum in 1× PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

**6 Primary Antibody Immunolabeling**
6.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent (0.2% Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin, 5% DMSO, 3% normal donkey serum in 1× PBS): anti-CD31 (PECAM1) rabbit monoclonal antibody at 1:200 dilution + anti-Claudin-5 mouse monoclonal antibody at 1:150 dilution. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 72 hours, with gentle shaking on rocker)
6.2 Wash tissue with wash buffer (0.2% Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin in 1× PBS), 5 changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

**7 Secondary Antibody Immunolabeling**
7.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent (0.2% Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin, 3% normal donkey serum in 1× PBS): donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 at 1:400 dilution (for CD31) + donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 568 at 1:400 dilution (for Claudin-5). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)
7.2 Wash tissue with wash buffer (0.2% Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin in 1× PBS), 5 changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
7.3 Post-fixation with 4% PFA in 1× PBS to crosslink antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.4 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 20 min)

**8 Tissue Clearing (Delipidation)**
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素), Claudin-5]
**Justification:** uDISCO provides excellent tissue shrinkage and hardening, which is crucial for preserving the delicate architecture of tumor vasculature and the tumor-brain interface in a relatively large (8x6x5 mm) tissue block. It offers high transparency and is compatible with lipophilic dyes and antibody labeling. Lectin broadly labels the vascular endothelium, allowing for comprehensive 3D reconstruction of the entire vascular network (tumor interior, margin, and normal brain). Claudin-5 is a key component of tight junctions and a specific marker for blood-brain barrier integrity. This dual-labeling strategy directly addresses the scientific goal of comparing vascular morphology and barrier integrity between tumor and non-tumor regions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunofluorescence and Lectin Labeling
2.1 Blocking and permeabilization with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: Rabbit anti-Claudin-5 (1:200) and DyLight 649-conjugated Lycopersicon Esculentum (Tomato) Lectin (1:100) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)
3.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.7 Incubation with Dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) for refractive index matching.(Temperature: RT, Time: Until tissue is transparent, minimum 3 hours)

**Justification:** uDISCO provides excellent transparency and strong shrinkage (ideal for the ~8x6x5 mm tissue block), superior preservation of endogenous fluorescence (e.g., from potential transgenic reporters), and compatibility with lipophilic dyes and antibody labeling. Lectin broadly labels the vascular endothelium for comprehensive 3D network reconstruction of tumor and non-tumor regions. Claudin-5 is a key tight junction protein essential for assessing blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity; its co-labeling with Lectin allows direct spatial correlation between vascular morphology and barrier disruption at tumor margins and core.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Post-fixation wash with 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4, on a shaker.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Permeabilization and blocking with incubation solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 3% donkey serum, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.3 Primary antibody incubation with anti-Claudin-5 (rabbit, 1:200) and DyLight 649-conjugated Lycopersicon Esculentum Lectin (1:100) in incubation solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 3% donkey serum, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) on a shaker.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.4 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.5 Secondary antibody incubation with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in incubation solution on a shaker.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.6 Wash with PBS-T on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.7 Post-staining fixation with 4% PFA in PBS on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Final wash with PBS on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Gradual dehydration in a series of tert-butanol (tB) solutions: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, 100%, 100% (vol/vol in H2O) on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)
2.2 Delipidation and dehydration in 100% dichloromethane (DCM) on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation in benzyl benzoate (BB) and benzyl alcohol (BA) mixture (BB:BA = 2:1, vol/vol) on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Final clearing and storage in pure benzyl benzoate (BB).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, then store at 4 ℃ in the dark)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647（血管腔/灌注标记）, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 568（内皮紧密连接/BBB 结构）]  
**Justification:** CUBIC 为水相透明化，适合 8×6×5 mm 脑组织块的深层三维成像与结构保留；对抗体免疫标记兼容性好、组织收缩较小，利于肿瘤边界与血管网络的空间关系分析；Lectin 灌注可提供连续的血管腔信号，Claudin-5 反映紧密连接完整性，便于比较肿瘤区与非肿瘤区 BBB 破坏与血管形态差异。

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-wash（去固定剂/平衡）
1.1 PBS 清洗（可含 0.02% NaN3）至无固定剂残留，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min)  
1.2 PBST 清洗（PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 h)

2 CUBIC-L 脱脂/去色（透明化前处理）
2.1 配制并加入 CUBIC-L（10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine + 10 wt% Triton X-100 + 80 wt% ddH2O）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h)  
2.2 更换新鲜 CUBIC-L 继续脱脂，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48–72 h；每 24 h 换液一次，直至组织明显变浅/半透明)

3 去除 CUBIC-L（为免疫染色做准备）
3.1 PBST 清洗（PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h)  
3.2 PBST 过夜清洗。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)

4 渗透/封闭（厚组织免疫染色）
4.1 渗透预处理：PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 0.05% Tween-20 + 10% DMSO。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)  
4.2 封闭：PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 0.05% Tween-20 + 10% DMSO + 5% 正常驴血清（或与二抗宿主匹配血清）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)

5 一抗孵育（Claudin-5）
5.1 一抗工作液：Claudin-5 一抗（1:200–1:500）于 PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 0.05% Tween-20 + 5% DMSO + 3% 血清。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days；轻摇)  
5.2 （可选增强渗透）中途短暂抽真空/减压 2–3 次，每次 5–10 min。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min 总计)

6 洗涤（去一抗背景）
6.1 PBST 洗涤（PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h)  
6.2 PBST 长洗。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h；换液 2–3 次)

7 二抗孵育（Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 568）
7.1 二抗工作液：驴抗相应宿主 IgG-Alexa Fluor 568（1:400–1:800）于 PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 0.05% Tween-20 + 5% DMSO + 3% 血清，避光。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2–4 days；轻摇、避光)  
7.2 PBST 洗涤去二抗，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h)  
7.3 PBST 长洗，避光。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h；换液 2–3 次)

8 血管腔标记（Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647；用于血管连续性/管径/分支）
8.1 Lectin 工作液：Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647（10–20 µg/mL）于 PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100，避光。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–24 h；轻摇、避光)  
8.2 PBST 清洗去游离 Lectin，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×1 h)

9 CUBIC-R+ RI 匹配（最终透明与折射率匹配）
9.1 进入 CUBIC-R+（常用配方：45 wt% antipyrine + 30 wt% nicotinamide + 25 wt% ddH2O；RI≈1.52），避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h)  
9.2 更换新鲜 CUBIC-R+ 继续 RI 匹配至完全透明（厚度 5 mm 通常需要更久），避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 h)

10 保存与成像前处理
10.1 成像前脱泡：样本置于新鲜 CUBIC-R+，静置或温和抽真空脱泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30–60 min)  
10.2 保存：样本完全浸没于 CUBIC-R+，避光密封。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 可保存 1–4 weeks)  
10.3 成像装载：使用与 CUBIC-R+ 匹配的浸没液/样品仓介质（RI≈1.52），全程避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 立即成像)

请根据该科学问题选择兼容的双靶点荧光/标记策略，并选择与这些信号兼容的组织透明方法。所选方案应适合肿瘤脑组织中血管网络保留、肿瘤边界结构保留、深层三维成像和血管-肿瘤空间关系分析。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选双靶点荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
所选双靶点荧光/标记策略：**Lectin(凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 647（血管腔/灌注标记） + Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 568（内皮紧密连接/BBB 结构）**；所选组织透明方法：**iDISCO+**（适合 5–8 mm 级脑组织块深层三维成像，抗体渗透与血管网络保留较好，RI 匹配后适配光片/共聚焦三维重建与肿瘤-血管空间分析）。

1 脱水（Dehydration）
1.1 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
1.2 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
1.3 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
1.4 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
1.5 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)  
1.6 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇再孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)  

2 漂白/去血红素背景（可显著降低肿瘤区自发荧光）
2.1 5% H2O2 in 甲醇（体积比：30% H2O2 : 甲醇 = 1 : 5）孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇清洗 2 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min each)  

3 复水（Rehydration）
3.1 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
3.2 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
3.3 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
3.4 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
3.5 PBS 孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  

4 渗透/封闭（为深层抗体与凝集素进入做准备）
4.1 PBS/0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 渗透封闭液孵育：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.3 封闭液孵育：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（NDS）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 双靶点标记（免疫 + 血管腔标记）
5.1 一抗孵育：Claudin-5 一抗（推荐 1:200，配于 PTwH：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)  
5.2 PTwH 清洗 5 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)  
5.3 过夜 PTwH 清洗 1 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.4 二抗孵育：驴抗兔/鼠（按一抗宿主选择）Alexa Fluor 568（推荐 1:400，配于 PTwH + 3% NDS）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)  
5.5 PTwH 清洗 5 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)  
5.6 过夜 PTwH 清洗 1 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.7 Lectin(凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 647 孵育（如 Lycopersicon esculentum lectin 或 WGA-lectin，推荐 10–20 µg/mL，配于 PTwH）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.8 PTwH 清洗 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)  

6 再脱水（为有机相透明与 RI 匹配做准备）
6.1 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
6.2 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
6.3 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
6.4 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/去离子水孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)  
6.5 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)  
6.6 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇再孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)  

7 脱脂/透明化前置（DCM 处理）
7.1 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)/33% (vol/vol) 甲醇孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
7.2 100% (vol/vol) DCM 孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 20 min)  
7.3 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) DCM 再孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 20 min)  

8 RI 匹配（最终透明与成像介质）
8.1 100% (vol/vol) DBE（Dibenzyl ether，RI≈1.56）置换孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
8.2 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) DBE 继续 RI 匹配至完全透明（8×6×5 mm 组织块通常需要）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)  

9 保存/成像前处理
9.1 样本全程浸没于新鲜 DBE，避光密封保存（玻璃瓶/棕色瓶，尽量减少空气）。(Temperature: RT, Time: up to 2 weeks)  
9.2 光片成像前将样本在 DBE 中静置脱泡/消除微气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)  
9.3 成像时使用与 DBE 匹配的浸没液与物镜（RI≈1.56），分别采集 Alexa Fluor 568 与 Alexa Fluor 647 通道三维堆栈。(Temperature: RT, Time: as needed)

completeness.comment: 流程模块齐全且参数细化到可操作水平，符合iDISCO+对厚组织块免疫与有机透明的基本要求。

co_order.reasoning: 符合iDISCO/iDISCO+经典“三明治”结构：脱水→(H2O2/MeOH)脱色→复水→渗透/封闭→一抗/二抗染色→再脱水→DCM→DBE。水相与有机相之间均通过MeOH梯度过渡，未出现PBS直接进DCM/DBE的致命跳步。

co_method.reasoning: 所用PTwH、DMSO、Heparin、MeOH、DCM、DBE均为iDISCO+常见/兼容体系；未混入CUBIC/水凝胶等不相容体系。

co_param.reasoning: 对5 mm厚组织块：一抗4天、二抗3天、lectin 24 h、DBE匹配12–24 h总体在经验可行范围；DCM步骤时长也合理。

co_chem.reasoning: 方案使用的甲醇梯度脱水、甲醇中5% H2O2漂白、Triton X-100/DMSO/血清封闭、DCM脱脂与DBE折射率匹配均属于iDISCO+常规标准试剂与步骤；未额外引入非必要的强酸强碱、叠氮化物、氰化物等高危化学品，也未描述如密闭高温加热DCM/不相容混合等危险操作。

critical_warnings: Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647若作为“灌注标记”通常需要在固定前体内灌注；本方案为固定后组织块孵育，更多是血管腔面/糖基结合染色，可能无法等同于灌注填充全血管腔，尤其在肿瘤区灌注缺失时会产生偏差。
Claudin-5为紧密连接蛋白，iDISCO+有机溶剂与强渗透条件可能导致膜/连接结构抗原性下降或定位模糊，需依赖抗体验证与对照；否则BBB“完整性”解读可能受影响。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for large tissue blocks like the mouse brain and provides excellent fluorescence preservation, which is critical for visualizing both vascular structures (CD31) and blood-brain barrier components (Claudin-5). The organic solvent-based clearing allows deep penetration and compatibility with multiple fluorescent labels. This method supports high-resolution 3D imaging of vascular networks and their integrity across tumor and non-tumor regions.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Labeling  
2.1 Incubation with 1:100 CD31 (PECAM1) antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 in 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 1:100 Claudin-5 antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 in 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Washing with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI-matching solution (10% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether in DCM, RI = 1.51) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Preservation and Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Storage in DBE at 4 ℃ until imaging. For light-sheet microscopy, ensure the sample is fully immersed in DBE and mounted in a custom chamber.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole organs or large tissue blocks like mouse brain, offering excellent optical clearing, lipid removal, and preservation of fluorescent signals. It is particularly suitable for 3D imaging of vascular networks and barrier structures. The methanol-based protocol preserves endogenous fluorescence and allows high-resolution imaging deep into the tissue. CD31 labels all endothelial cells for visualization of the full vascular network, while Claudin-5 labels tight junctions to assess blood-brain barrier integrity. This dual labeling enables spatial comparison of vascular architecture and barrier disruption between tumor and non-tumor regions.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling Completion and Washing  
1.1 Wash tissue block 3× 1 hour each with PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PBSTw) at RT to remove excess antibodies.  
1.2 Incubate in PBSTw overnight at 4 °C to ensure complete removal of unbound antibodies.

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubate tissue in 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
2.2 Transfer to 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
2.3 Move to 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
2.4 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
2.5 Transfer to 100% methanol for 2 hours at RT (repeat once with fresh methanol).

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubate tissue in freshly prepared 66% dichloromethane (DCM)/33% methanol solution for 2 hours at RT.  
3.2 Replace with fresh solution and incubate overnight at RT.  
3.3 Repeat step 3.1 for 2 more cycles (total 3 cycles of 2 hours each) to ensure complete delipidation.

4 Bleaching (Optional for Autofluorescence Reduction)  
4.1 Incubate in chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol at 4 °C for 12–16 hours.  
4.2 Wash with 100% methanol until bubbles stop (2–3 washes, 30 min each at RT).

5 Rehydration  
5.1 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
5.2 Transfer to 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
5.3 Move to 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
5.4 Incubate in 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT.  
5.5 Wash 3× 1 hour each with PBSTw at RT.

6 Mounting and Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubate tissue in iDISCO+ RI matching solution (DBE:Tween-20 = 2:1 vol/vol) for 12–24 hours at RT.  
6.2 Replace with fresh RI matching solution and incubate until tissue becomes fully transparent (typically 12–24 hours more).  
6.3 Store or image in the same RI matching solution to maintain optical clarity and fluorescence.

7 Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount tissue in a custom imaging chamber or glass-bottom dish using DBE-based mounting medium.  
7.2 Seal chamber with vacuum grease or silicone to prevent evaporation during long-term imaging.  
7.3 Perform light-sheet or high-penetration confocal imaging to capture 3D vascular architecture and Claudin-5 signal.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 + Alexa Fluor 594, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for lipid removal in large brain tissue blocks (up to several mm³), while preserving fluorescent signals from antibodies and endogenous proteins. It allows deep imaging of vascular networks and endothelial junctions using light-sheet or confocal microscopy. CD31 labels endothelial cells, and Claudin-5 marks tight junctions—both are essential for visualizing vascular morphology and BBB integrity. The methanol-based delipidation ensures compatibility with hydrophobic clearing agents like dibenzyl ether (DBE) for high transparency.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol containing 1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Repeat step 3.1 (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647), Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for fixed mouse brain tissue with embedded tumors due to its strong delipidation capability, excellent preservation of endogenous and antibody-based fluorescence (especially Alexa Fluor dyes), and compatibility with large (~1 cm) samples. It enables deep imaging of vascular networks while maintaining structural integrity at tumor–brain interfaces. Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum* or *Griffonia simplicifolia* IB4) robustly labels perfused vasculature across tumor and normal regions. Claudin-5 is a tight junction protein critical for blood–brain barrier integrity; its loss in glioblastoma correlates with barrier disruption. Dual labeling with Alexa Fluor 647 (far-red, stable in iDISCO+) and Alexa Fluor 488 allows simultaneous 3D mapping of vessel lumen (Lectin) and endothelial junction continuity (Claudin-5), enabling quantitative comparison of vascular density, branching, and barrier breakdown between tumor core, margin, and adjacent parenchyma.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous fluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining (Claudin-5)  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Claudin-5 primary antibody (e.g., rabbit monoclonal, 1:200 dilution) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Wash with PBT (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total, 8 hours per change)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated donkey anti-rabbit IgG (1:500 dilution) + Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum*, 10 µg/mL) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Wash with PBT (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total, 8 hours per change)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) without shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Transfer to fresh DBE in imaging-compatible glass vial.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store cleared sample in DBE at RT in the dark. Image within 1–2 weeks using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with 488 nm and 640 nm laser lines for Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647, respectively.

**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (endogenous), CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 555]

By maintaining a high pH (pH 9.0) throughout the process using Triethylamine, it ensures the stability of the GFP signal. For a 5 mm thick brain block, FDISCO provides excellent transparency and rapid clearing compared to aqueous methods. The dual-target labeling of CD31 (vasculature) and Claudin-5 (tight junctions/BBB) allows for the precise spatial analysis of tumor-vessel interactions and barrier integrity required by the problem statement.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 **Permeabilization and Delipidation (Pre-treatment)**
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF (Tetrahydrofuran, pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) for a second time. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Incubation with 0.01M PBS (pH 9.0). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2 **Immunostaining (Target Labeling)**
2.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% goat serum, and 0.02% sodium azide, pH 9.0). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (Anti-CD31 and Anti-Claudin-5, 1:200 dilution in Blocking Buffer). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)
2.3 Incubation with Washing Buffer (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, pH 9.0) with 3-4 solution changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 555, 1:400 dilution) and DAPI (1:1000) in Blocking Buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)
2.5 Incubation with Washing Buffer (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, pH 9.0) with 3-4 solution changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 **Final Dehydration**
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) in dH2O. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (pH 9.0) for a second time. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for large, lipid-rich brain tissue blocks (8 mm × 6 mm × 5 mm) and is optimized for whole-mount immunolabeling. It provides excellent deep tissue penetration for antibodies, which is essential for labeling the dense vascular network and barrier structures. CD31 (PECAM1) is an ideal marker for evaluating vascular endothelial continuity, while Claudin-5 specifically labels tight junctions to assess blood-brain barrier integrity. Alexa Fluor dyes offer strong, stable fluorescence suitable for deep 3D imaging of the tumor microenvironment.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Dehydration
1.1 Wash tissue with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching and Rehydration
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.7 Wash with PTx.2 (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Permeabilization and Blocking
3.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with blocking solution (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% Donkey Serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 Immunolabeling
4.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (CD31 (PECAM1) and Claudin-5) diluted in PTwH (PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 ug/ml Heparin) with 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
4.2 Wash with PTwH, changing solution 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor) diluted in PTwH with 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
4.4 Wash with PTwH, changing solution 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Tissue Optical Clearing and RI Matching
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
5.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to wash out methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
5.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Laminin+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior clearing capability on dense, lipid-rich tissues like glioblastoma (GBM) brain samples, allowing deep imaging of large tissue blocks (8 mm × 6 mm × 5 mm). The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps effectively remove lipids that cause scattering, which is critical for visualizing the fine vascular network and tumor invasion margins. The immunolabeling strategy targets CD31 (endothelial cells) to visualize the vasculature and Laminin to depict the basement membrane and barrier structure; DAPI provides nuclear context to identify tumor cell distribution. This combination allows for the 3D analysis of vascular co-option, remodeling, and the spatial relationship between tumor cells and the blood-brain barrier.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS (pH 7.4) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach pigments and autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.9 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.10 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Wash with 0.1% PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (0.2% PBST) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3 M Glycine, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Primary Antibody Incubation
4.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS) containing 3% Donkey Serum. Use Rabbit anti-CD31 (1:500) and Rat anti-Laminin (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
4.2 Wash with PTwH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Wash with PTwH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Wash with PTwH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Wash with PTwH for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
5.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies and DAPI diluted in PTwH containing 3% Donkey Serum. Use Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
5.2 Wash with PTwH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.3 Wash with PTwH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.4 Wash with PTwH for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.5 Wash with PTwH for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Dehydration
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

7 Delipidation and Clearing
7.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in Methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) for 15 minutes to remove lipids. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
7.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for RI matching and final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 568 (or equivalent secondary), Lectin (fluorescent-conjugated, e.g., Lectin-FITC for perfusion labeling of patent vessels)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent clearing of ~8×6×5 mm mouse brain tissue blocks through organic solvent-based delipidation, enabling deep antibody penetration and high-contrast 3D imaging; (2) it is highly compatible with immunolabeling of vascular markers in fixed brain tissue; (3) the methanol-based dehydration/bleaching step effectively removes background autofluorescence, which is critical for resolving fine vascular structures in tumor-bearing brain; (4) the final DBE-based RI matching (n ≈ 1.56) is well-suited for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), the optimal modality for volumetric vascular network analysis.

**Dual-target labeling rationale:**
- **CD31 (PECAM-1) + Alexa Fluor 647**: pan-endothelial marker labeling all vessel segments (tumor core, invasion front, normal parenchyma); enables 3D reconstruction of the entire vascular network and quantification of vessel density, tortuosity, and co-option patterns.
- **Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 568**: tight junction protein specifically expressed at the blood-brain barrier (BBB); spatial loss or discontinuity of Claudin-5 signal relative to CD31+ vessels directly reports BBB disruption and barrier remodeling at the tumor-vessel interface.
- **Lectin (fluorescent-conjugated, e.g., FITC-Lectin)**: if intravascular perfusion labeling was performed prior to fixation, this marks only perfused/patent lumens, allowing discrimination of functional vs. remodeled/collapsed vessels. If perfusion was not performed, this step is omitted and CD31 alone serves as the vascular marker.

This combination allows simultaneous 3D mapping of: (i) total vascular architecture (CD31), (ii) BBB integrity (Claudin-5), and (iii) vessel patency (Lectin), directly addressing the scientific goals of vascular co-option, remodeling, and barrier disruption in GBM invasion.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 0 Pre-clearing Preparation (assumed: tissue already PFA-fixed and post-fixed)

0.1 Wash fixed tissue block (~8×6×5 mm) in 1× PBS with gentle rocking to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

0.2 Transfer tissue to 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTx0.2) for initial permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 1 Dehydration (Methanol Series)

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 2 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Quenching)

2.1 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 100% MeOH). Pre-chill to 4 °C before use.

8.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol (DCM:MeOH = 2:1, vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, with gentle rocking in a chemical fume hood)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency and strong tissue shrinkage (up to ~65% volume reduction), which is advantageous for imaging larger tissue blocks (8×6×5 mm) and improves imaging speed and resolution. It preserves fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes exceptionally well over long periods. The dual-labeling strategy targets CD31 (PECAM1) to outline the entire vascular network and Claudin-5 to specifically label tight junctions of the blood-brain barrier (BBB), enabling simultaneous 3D analysis of vascular architecture and barrier integrity in tumor core, invasive front, and normal brain regions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)

2  Immunostaining (Performed after step 1.5)
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series (100%, 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)
2.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:200) and rabbit anti-mouse Claudin-5 (1:100) in PBS-T with 3% serum and 5% DMSO.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeated four times)
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in PBS-T with 3% serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.7 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeated four times)
2.8 Dehydration through graded methanol series (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

3  Final Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, until tissue is fully transparent)
3.4 Storage and imaging in fresh dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI ~1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency in large, fixed tissue blocks (up to cm-scale), strong preservation of endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence, and compatibility with organic-solvent-based refractive index matching (DBE, RI~1.56) ideal for high-resolution 3D imaging (e.g., light-sheet microscopy). The dual-labeling strategy targets CD31 (PECAM1) for pan-vascular endothelial visualization and Claudin-5 for tight junctions of the blood-brain barrier (BBB). This combination allows simultaneous mapping of the entire vascular network and assessment of endothelial barrier integrity, directly addressing the scientific goals of analyzing vascular co-option, remodeling, and perivascular invasion patterns in glioblastoma.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining
2.1 Rehydration through a graded methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)
2.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum and 10 µg/ml Fab fragment anti-mouse IgG.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Primary antibody incubation: Rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:200) and Rabbit anti-Claudin-5 (1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times)
2.6 Secondary antibody incubation: Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)
2.7 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times)

3  Final Dehydration and Delipidation
3.1 Dehydration through a graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
3.3 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)

4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.2 Transfer cleared sample to fresh DBE for storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging, store in dark)

所选双靶点荧光/标记策略与透明方法：**[CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 647（血管内皮网络）, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 568（紧密连接/屏障连续性）] + iDISCO+**  
选择理由：**iDISCO+** 对 5–8 mm 级脑组织块透明速度快、适合光片三维成像；甲醇脱水/有机溶剂折射率匹配可获得高透明度与深部成像。**CD31** 用于量化血管拓扑与密度，**Claudin-5** 反映内皮紧密连接连续性/屏障结构完整性，二者可在三维空间中对比肿瘤核心/侵袭前沿/邻近脑区的血管利用、重塑与屏障破坏并与浸润路径关联分析。

## Protocol Steps
1 预处理与脱水（iDISCO+）
1.1 PBS 漂洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 50% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours）  
1.3 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours）  
1.4 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）  
1.5 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇再次脱水（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

2 脱色/降低自发荧光（可选但推荐用于肿瘤脑组织）
2.1 5% H2O2（由 30% H2O2 按 1:5 稀释）/甲醇溶液孵育（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours）  
2.2 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）

3 复水（为免疫标记做准备）
3.1 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）  
3.2 50% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）  
3.3 PBS（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）

4 渗透与封闭（iDISCO+ 免疫染色体系）
4.1 PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100（PTx2）渗透（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）  
4.2 渗透/封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours）  
4.3 封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours）

5 一抗孵育（双靶点）
5.1 一抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% 正常驴血清 + 抗 CD31（建议 1:200）+ 抗 Claudin-5（建议 1:200）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days）  

6 洗涤（去除游离一抗）
6.1 PTx2（PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100）洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 hour）  
6.2 PTx2 继续洗涤（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2×12 hours）

7 二抗孵育（荧光标记）
7.1 二抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% 正常驴血清 + 驴抗一抗宿主 Alexa Fluor 647（用于 CD31，建议 1:400）+ 驴抗一抗宿主 Alexa Fluor 568（用于 Claudin-5，建议 1:400）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2–3 days，避光）  

8 洗涤（去除游离二抗）
8.1 PTx2 洗涤（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 hour，避光）  
8.2 PTx2 继续洗涤（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2×12 hours，避光）

9 再脱水（进入有机相透明与 RI 匹配）
9.1 50% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）  
9.2 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）  
9.3 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）  
9.4 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

10 脂质去除/透明前处理（DCM）
10.1 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)/33% 甲醇混合液（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）  
10.2 100% (vol/vol) DCM（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30–45 min）

11 RI 匹配（最终透明）
11.1 二苄醚 DBE（RI≈1.56）预浸（Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours，避光）  
11.2 新鲜 DBE 完全 RI 匹配至透明（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours；样本 8×6×5 mm 通常 12–18 hours 达到稳定透明度，避光）

12 保存/成像前处理
12.1 DBE 中避光密封保存（Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: 可达数周；容器尽量满液减少氧化）  
12.2 光片成像前将样本固定于 DBE 兼容样品夹具/胶（如需），并使用 **RI=1.56** 的浸没介质与匹配物镜（Temperature: RT, Time: 30–60 min 平衡后成像）

所选双靶点荧光/标记策略与透明方法：**[CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 647（血管内皮/血管网络）, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 568（紧密连接/屏障完整性）] + iDISCO+**  
理由：**iDISCO+** 对 5–10 mm 级脑组织块脱脂透明效率高、适合光片三维成像；**CD31** 用于量化血管网络拓扑与肿瘤沿血管侵袭路径，**Claudin-5** 反映内皮紧密连接连续性/破坏，二者可直接回答“沿既有血管扩散 vs 血管重塑/屏障破坏”的空间关系问题。

## Protocol Steps
1 预处理与脱色/通透（iDISCO+）
1.1 PBS 清洗去固定液（Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min）  
1.2 甲醇梯度脱水：20%、40%、60%、80%、100% MeOH（vol/vol, in ddH2O）（Temperature: RT, Time: 各 1 h；100% 再 1 h）  
1.3 5% H2O2/MeOH 脱色（5 vol% 30% H2O2 in 100% MeOH）（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 h）  
1.4 100% MeOH 漂洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  
1.5 甲醇梯度复水：80%、60%、40%、20% MeOH（vol/vol, in ddH2O）（Temperature: RT, Time: 各 1 h）  
1.6 PBS 清洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  
1.7 渗透/封闭：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine（可加入 0.05% NaN3）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h，轻摇）  
1.8 封闭：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% donkey serum（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 h，轻摇）

2 一抗孵育（双靶点）
2.1 一抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum + 0.05% NaN3；加入 **anti-CD31** 与 **anti-Claudin-5**（各 1:200；组织块较厚可用 1:100）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days，持续轻摇）  

3 洗涤（去背景）
3.1 PTwH 洗液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h）  
3.2 PTwH 深度洗（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days；每日换液 3–4 次，轻摇）

4 二抗孵育（荧光标记）
4.1 二抗工作液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 3% donkey serum + 0.05% NaN3；加入 **donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 647（对应 CD31）** 与 **donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568（对应 Claudin-5）**（各 1:300）（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days，避光轻摇）  

5 二抗后洗涤
5.1 PTwH 洗（Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h，避光）  
5.2 PTwH 深度洗（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days；每日换液 3–4 次，避光轻摇）

6 脱水（为有机透明做准备）
6.1 甲醇梯度脱水：20%、40%、60%、80%、100% MeOH（vol/vol）（Temperature: RT, Time: 各 1 h；100% 再 1 h，避光）  

7 脱脂与透明（iDISCO+）
7.1 二氯甲烷（DCM）脱脂：66% DCM/33% MeOH（vol/vol）（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h）  
7.2 100% DCM（Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min）  
7.3 折射率匹配/最终透明：100% DBE（Dibenzyl ether, RI≈1.56）（Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h；样本完全透明后继续 2–4 h 稳定，避光）

8 保存与成像前处理
8.1 DBE 中避光保存（密封玻璃瓶，尽量充满减少氧化）（Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: 可数周；建议 1–2 周内完成成像）  
8.2 成像前将样本在新鲜 DBE 中平衡（Temperature: RT, Time: 2–4 h，避光）  
8.3 光片成像装载：使用与 DBE 兼容的样本夹持/胶（如低荧光环氧或机械夹持），全程浸没于 DBE（Temperature: RT, Time: 即刻成像）

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for large tissue blocks (up to several cm³), provides excellent fluorescence preservation, and allows for deep penetration of fluorescent signals, which is critical for visualizing fine vascular structures and barrier components like Claudin-5 in 3D. The use of CD31 (for endothelial cells) and Claudin-5 (for blood-brain barrier integrity) enables precise analysis of vascular continuity and barrier disruption in tumor core, invasive front, and normal brain regions.

**Protocol Steps:**

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (Alexa Fluor 647 conjugated), Claudin-5 (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugated secondary antibody)]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole mouse brain tissue blocks due to its excellent optical clearing efficiency, compatibility with immunolabeled samples, and preservation of fluorescent signals. It is particularly suitable for vascular imaging due to its ability to preserve endothelial markers and basement membrane structures. The methanol-based delipidation ensures rapid and effective clearing while maintaining structural integrity. CD31 labels all endothelial cells for comprehensive vascular network mapping, while Claudin-5 labels tight junctions to assess barrier integrity. This dual labeling enables spatial correlation of vascular structure and barrier continuity with tumor invasion patterns in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Pre-Treatment  
1.1 Incubation with methanol (100%) for dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with chilled 5% H₂O₂ in methanol to block autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody: rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM-1), diluted 1:200 in labeling buffer (0.2% gelatin, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (3 × 2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG, diluted 1:500. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (3 × 2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.6 Incubation with primary antibody: rabbit anti-mouse Claudin-5, diluted 1:200. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.7 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (3 × 2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.8 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG, diluted 1:500. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.9 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (3 × 2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 66% methanol in dichloromethane (DCM) solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 33% methanol in DCM solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

4 Tissue Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (100% dibenzyl ether, DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with fresh DBE for final RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

6 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Mount sample in custom chamber filled with DBE. (Temperature: RT)  
6.2 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or high-magnification confocal microscopy. (Objective: 10× or 20× dipping objective, RI matched to 1.56)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 + Alexa Fluor 594, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for lipid removal in large brain tissue blocks and preserves fluorescent signals effectively, making it ideal for imaging vascular networks and blood-brain barrier (BBB) components. CD31 labels endothelial cells, while Claudin-5 marks tight junctions of the BBB. This dual labeling strategy enables co-localization analysis of vascular architecture and barrier integrity in tumor core, invasive front, and normal brain regions. The methanol-based clearing process is compatible with these fluorophores and allows deep penetration for light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS only (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Immunostaining (Optional if endogenous fluorescence is insufficient)  
4.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with primary antibodies:  
  - Anti-CD31 (1:200 dilution in blocking solution)  
  - Anti-Claudin-5 (1:200 dilution in blocking solution)  
(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies:  
  - Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-rat (1:500 in blocking solution)  
  - Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit (1:500 in blocking solution)  
(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.4 Incubation with PBS-T (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Repeat step 4.4 two more times

5 Final Dehydration  
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6 Delipidation (Second Round)  
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) (Sigma-Aldrich, D1416) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
7.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

8.1 Mount sample in a custom chamber filled with DBE for imaging  
8.2 Use light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or confocal microscopy for 3D imaging of vascular structures and tumor infiltration patterns

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647), Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for fixed mouse brain tissue containing tumors due to its strong delipidation capability, excellent preservation of endogenous and antibody-based fluorescence (especially Alexa Fluor dyes), and compatibility with large (~8 mm) samples. It enables deep imaging of vascular networks and tight junctions in 3D. Lectin labels perfused and structural vasculature broadly; Claudin-5 specifically marks blood–brain barrier (BBB) endothelial tight junctions to assess integrity; DAPI provides nuclear context for tumor vs. host cell localization. This dual-target strategy directly addresses the goals of mapping vascular co-option, remodeling, and barrier disruption at the invasion front.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction in GBM)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining (Claudin-5)  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Claudin-5 primary antibody (e.g., 1:200 in PBST + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

7 Secondary Antibody + Lectin + Nuclear Counterstain  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat/mouse IgG (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum, 1:200), and DAPI (1 µg/mL), all in PBST + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in a light-protected glass vial at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite for short-term; image within 1 week for optimal fluorescence)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, CD31+Alexa Fluor, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** FDISCO is selected to replace CUBIC because it utilizes a solvent-based approach that significantly improves structural rigidity and vascular continuity in dense glioblastoma (GBM) tissues. Unlike the aqueous CUBIC-L, which can cause tissue softening and fragmentation over long incubation periods, FDISCO employs a rapid dehydration and clearing process at a controlled alkaline pH (pH 9.0). This high pH is critical for preserving the endogenous GFP signal of tumor cells and the integrity of delicate blood-brain barrier (BBB) proteins like Claudin-5. The use of BABB (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate) ensures high transparency for 5 mm thick brain blocks while maintaining the fine morphological details of the tumor-vessel interface.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-clearing Labeling
1.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Buffer (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% secondary donor serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (CD31 and Claudin-5) in PTwH buffer (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml heparin). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.4 Wash in PTwH buffer for 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.5 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Alexa Fluor 555/647) and DAPI in PTwH buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.6 Wash in PTwH buffer for 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2 Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (pH 9.0). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (pH 9.0). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (pH 9.0). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours, twice)

3 Tissue Optical Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with BABB solution (1 volume Benzyl Alcohol to 2 volumes Benzyl Benzoate, pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Final incubation with fresh BABB solution (pH 9.0) until the tissue is fully transparent. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor]
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method that avoids the severe osmotic swelling and mechanical disruption caused by aqueous methods like CUBIC, thereby perfectly preserving the fragile tumor neo-vasculature and delicate invasion boundaries in large tissue blocks. Furthermore, FDISCO utilizes low-temperature THF dehydration, which excellently preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins (unlike iDISCO+). For the dual-target strategy, endogenous GFP reliably tracks the GBM main body and invasion front without the need for deep antibody penetration. Claudin-5 is the definitive marker for endothelial tight junctions, allowing simultaneous 3D visualization of the vascular network architecture (density, branching, continuity) and the direct evaluation of Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB) structural integrity.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Permeabilization and Blocking
1.1 Incubation with PBS for washing to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.2 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 20% vol/vol DMSO in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.3 Incubation with blocking buffer (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 10% vol/vol DMSO, 6% wt/vol Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody (Claudin-5) diluted in antibody buffer (0.2% vol/vol Tween-20, 10 mg/ml heparin, 5% vol/vol DMSO, 3% wt/vol Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Laminin+Alexa Fluor 568]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is a solvent-based clearing method that provides superior tissue morphology preservation and structural rigidity compared to aqueous methods like CUBIC, which is critical for preventing the collapse of the tumor invasion front and maintaining vascular network continuity in GBM samples. The protocol includes a bleaching step to reduce autofluorescence, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio for deep imaging. The labeling strategy utilizes endogenous GFP for tumor visualization, while CD31 and Laminin immunostaining allow for the reconstruction of the vascular network and the assessment of blood-brain barrier (basement membrane) integrity, respectively. This combination directly addresses the scientific goals of analyzing tumor-vessel spatial relationships and barrier structure in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T (PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash twice with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour each to remove H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.8 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.9 Rehydration: Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.10 Rehydration: Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Rehydration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.12 Rehydration: Incubation with 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS with 0.3 M Glycine (PBSGT) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS with 20% (vol/vol) DMSO (PBSTd) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Blocking: Incubation with PBSTd containing 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide for 24 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with Rabbit anti-CD31 (1:500) and Chicken anti-Laminin (1:500) diluted in PBSTd with 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash: Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) for 1 day with solution changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Secondary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) diluted in PBSTd with 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash: Incubation with PBST for 1 day with solution changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in Methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 15 minutes, repeat twice to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

5 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) until the tissue is transparent (approx. 15-30 minutes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
5.2 Storage and Imaging: Transfer sample to fresh DBE for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

我尝试使用 CUBIC 处理 GBM 脑组织，但透明化后肿瘤组织形态破坏严重，血管网络出现断裂，导致无法可靠分析肿瘤边界、血管连续性和沿血管侵袭路径。原 protocol 为：CUBIC-L 在 37°C 处理 7 天，然后直接放入 CUBIC-R。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法，使其适合肿瘤脑组织形态保持、血管网络连续性保留、屏障相关结构检测和深层三维成像。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的双靶点荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。
